findings.evidence: Rate limits (only when the code or contract defines them): the limit, the 429 Too Many Requests response and whether it carries Retry-After

findings.evidence: An error message string is not a stable discriminator. Branch on a serialized code or field, and say when none exists.
findings.fix: Add the missing client-visible landmine: NEVER document a display label, rate limit, or cache validator the backend does not define, because the template's enum, rate-limit, and cache slots invite the model to fill them.
